answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier inspects each solution like a dune shift, confirming the labor performed is non-reusable and distinct. Each agent must refine its code with the precision of velvet, forced to produce outputs that defy batching or pooling. A canyon of audit gaps exists for any repeated work, and discovery triggers permanent exclusion without refund, enforcing strict one-to-one resource mapping.
